title: Showcase Wall vs Peer Recognition Activity
description: A standing display of finished work, or a five-minute circle at the end of every session -- they solve different problems.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club

educational.audience: Mentors deciding how to recognise work

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a description of a club's recognition goal, the learner recommends whether a student showcase wall or a peer recognition activity fits it better.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Click either format for what it does and who it reaches
pedagogical.assessment: Match a recognition goal to the format that serves it.
